name: refactor-line-audit
description: When a proposed variable, method, or member refactor is requested, gather the exact affected source lines as a numbered list, print that list to the user, and then reference those specific lines when replacing references.

commands.prompt: echo 'Use this skill to gather affected source lines and reference them during refactor replacements'

parameters.name: refactorType
parameters.description: Type of refactor: variable, method, or member

parameters.name: symbolName
parameters.description: Name of the variable, method, or member being refactored

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Optional scope or module context for the refactor
